eyebrow: Sudden Hearing Loss vs. Earwax Buildup

items.name: Earwax is gradual, this is sudden
No change after ear picking is a sign

closing.headline: If one ear suddenly goes muffled, don't assume it's earwax.
closing.tip: If digging with an ear pick doesn't help at all, suspect sudden hearing loss instead.
closing.cta: See an ENT or the ER for steroid treatment within the 72-hour window.
